review.official:
Blue Poison's real identity remains unknown and her background a mystery. She is highly skilled at neutralizing targets using toxins.
Now as a
sniper
with
Rhodes Island
, she regularly contributes her expertise in toxicology research.

files.description:
Imaging test for this operator showed clear outline of internal organs without unusual dark spots. No abnormal traces of Originium particles present in her system. No signs of infection, confirming her as uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0% 
Operator Blue Poison shows no symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.1u/L 
Operator Blue Poison rarely comes into contact with Originium.

Although her personality is quite lovely, Blue Poison's abilities are in fact as terrifying as the rumors say, which has undoubtedly become a hindrance for her when communicating with other operators. But when she finishes her combat work and quietly undertakes the medical task of curing poison, the sincere, peaceful girl behind her deadly abilities shows through. 
The small crossbow she uses has proven to be a powerful long-range weapon, and the tips coated with her toxic serum make a hit even more lethal. Still, Blue Poison never lets an enemy die in agony, deeming that far too cruel.

According to Blue Poison's personal account, she realized the truth behind 'poison' when she was little, i.e., any creature, living or not, has weaknesses that can be magnified and exploited to a fatal end. 
The toxin produced by her venomous abilities is monitored and sampled daily by Dr. Kal'tsit personally. Blue Poison feels better about Rhodes Island's diversity, and the group's open-mindedness to her abilities such that she can use them to her full potential. 
She is more defensive on the issue of describing herself as 'toxic.' The question was if would she accept her poisonous nature if the other operators accepted her and no longer kept their distance? Blue Poison didn't give a straight answer, politely deflecting the question as usual. 
Does she still hate her powers? Or has she accepted them while still feeling about her relationship with other people? It's something only the Doctor can figure out with Blue Poison.

What is certain is that Blue Poison's toxic reputation has grown due to her unique combat techniques, which will no doubt impact her daily life. 
As for her so-called 'poison' power, the Medic Operators have never revealed any of their test results publicly. But it has been determined that normal physical contact with her will not contract the poison. In fact, her 'poison power' manifests mostly in her skill with and knowledge of poison. 
In her spare time, Blue Poison is interested in much more mundane variety things, such as baking. Operator Gummy, currently assigned to kitchen duty in Logistics, has claimed that Blue Poison's desserts are so good, they could 'convert someone who hates sweets!' Another unnamed Operator who has also tasted her treats echoed the sentiment that Blue Poison is proficient enough to start a bakery--if she made better choices in visual presentation. 
Aside from dessert making, Blue Poison has a keen sense of and passion for fashion, having already made several suggestions about her costume to Logistics and Trade.

According to a report leaked from certain secret sources, Blue Poison has been spotted in several battles against gigantic creatures. There are no images or any concrete evidence to corroborate these accounts, however. 
Blue Poison has indicated no signs of involvement in such battles, nor has she mentioned them. 
[CLASSIFIED] 
According to eyewitness accounts, Operator Blue Poison greeted Operator Specter by name when she saw her for the first time. But since Blue Poison is polite to every operator, it was dismissed as insignificant. All similar reports must be scrutinized to avoid unwanted speculations about specific operators.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Greetings, Doctor. You're glowing today. To see you so well... it's all I could ever hope for.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: I prepared an antidote to nullify the effects of any common poison. I'd like you to take one dose before every battle. Do you mind?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Actually, the toxin in my body is an ingredient in some high-quality medicines. That's why Dr. Kal'tsit needs me in her lab a lot.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hmm, why do you keep staring at me... You mean, it's because my eye color is special? Is that a compliment, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm the one our enemies fear the most. After all, who wouldn't want to kill me before I can torture them to death with my poison? What really worries me is that my teammates might think the same…

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Why am I staring at this cake? Actually... I baked it to share with everyone, but no one wanted it... Would you like to try it, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Doctor, you're always wearing the same outfit. How about I choose some new clothes for you? I think I have pretty good taste. Oh... it's a uniform? So you can't change it? Okay…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I'm 'toxic'... so people prefer to stay away from me. But now I have you by my side, Doctor, and I'm really, really happy.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: My body isn't that different from everyone else. I may be 'toxic,' but nothing bad will happen if someone touches me. Doctor, if you can prove this to everyone, then maybe they won't always keep away from me. Could you... hold my hand out there?

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Oh, already asleep. Gotta find a blanket to keep the Doctor warm...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Nice to meet you, I'm Blue Poison. I'm sure Dr. Kal'tsit must have told you about me. In that case, it'll be up to you to decide how to use my 'toxic' powers.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: I think I hear the sound of toxic liquid boiling, like music to my ears.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you so much... I'm so glad I get to help out in all these battles. It's like a dream come true.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I used to hold back and hide my 'toxic' self, but now I've accepted what I am, trying to move forward to change my fate. I have you to thank for helping me make this shift, Doctor. You have my sincerest gratitude.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Great. I'm good at supporting assaults.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I'd be much better off supporting the others. Wouldn't want my poison to harm you, Doctor...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Everyone, there's no need for you all to stand so far from me...

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I prepared a 'gift' for you. Like it?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Awaiting your orders.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Please don't be scared of me.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Don't worry, my poison is not contagious.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: My toxicant is ready.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: My toxins will slowly burn your life away...

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Are you hallucinating?

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Honey to me, poison to you.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Poison kiss.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Use poison to fight the evils and crimes... Isn't that ironic to you?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: I've got a poison to melt away all these remains in an instant. Want me to show you?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Good, finished before my clothes got dirty.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: How ridiculous. Feels like I killed myself with my own poison...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Resting when you're tired helps you focus on your work.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Huh?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: D-Did you just touch me? C-Can you do that again? Please?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Well there, Doctor, Happy New Year. Although, given what day it is, won't you take your uniform off? I was assuming you'd put on something new, but maybe you just don't pay much attention to your appearence.  It's a little frustrating—I have no idea what would be a good gift for you.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. A dessert from me—please, take it. And if it's okay, I'd like you to give it a taste right now. What is it? Everyone's watching? I don't see the problem. You're a regular whenever I make snacks, aren't you?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I am a 'toxic' person, but I still have a place of my own here... It makes me so happy. The operators might still be slightly scared of me, but that's it. They don't reject me that much. Just give it enough time, and the relationships between us will be fine, won't they?
